contract.filter: Butterworth prototype order 4 (bandpass order 8), 0.5-45 Hz, causal SOS, continuous per recording, zero initial state
contract.kurtosis: Pearson population kurtosis (Gaussian=3), no excess or bias correction
contract.degenerate_band: mobility=0 and kurtosis=0 when variance is zero
contract.transport: decoded floating-point physical features, no prior normalization; unrounded
contract.fpga_numerical_parity: Not yet validated against RTL / fixed-point output
contract.label_rule: Sleep epochs only. OA/X/CA/CAA=1; sleep without respiratory codes=0. Hypopnea-only, wake/movement/unknown and startup epochs excluded.
contract.source_annotation_alignment: Each .st annotation applies to the following 30 seconds; use its exact sample index.

report.split_method: Subject-disjoint fixed holdout; grouped CV within development subjects only
report.evaluation_note: Window-level point estimates on a small cohort; correlated windows are not independent patients. Test subjects were not used for tuning or refitting. The fixed holdout was inspected during implementation; treat this as a provisional development benchmark and validate on a new cohort. Model selection used development CV only.
